_about: George John Romanes (1848-1894), Darwin's younger colleague, on mind, evolution and belief: Mental Evolution in Man (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, 1888); Darwin, and After Darwin, 3 vols. (Chicago: Open Court; vol. I the fourth edition, 1910; vol. II first 1895, the etext from the 1916 printing; vol. III first 1897, the etext from the 1906 printing); Mind and Motion and Monism (London: Longmans, Green, 1895); Thoughts on Religion, edited by Charles Gore (Longmans, Green; the etext is the twelfth impression, 1904). Clean Gutenberg texts. Wanted: A Candid Examination of Theism (1878; PG 19003 would not download). US public domain. Added in round 2026-10-18cb from Gutenberg: The Scientific Evidences of Organic Evolution (1882), Animal Intelligence (1882) and An Examination of Weismannism (1893). Not taken: the zoology of Jelly-Fish, Star-Fish and Sea-Urchins, and the Life and Letters by his widow. No uids minted.
